title: Sandy’s Seacrest | Spacious Seacrest Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Sandy’s Seacrest is a pet-friendly, one-level Seacrest home with a private pool, fenced yard, bikes, and quick access to the beach and 30A dining.
description_expanded: Sandy's Seacrest Features - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, non-aggressive breeds only. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. - Large fenced-in and landscaped backyard with private pool - pool heating available for all reservations with arrivals October through April for an additional fee - Enjoy 3 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape for your arrival - 2 Minute bike ride to Seabreeze Beach Access - 2 Minute bike ride to Waterhouse Sandwich and Wine Bar - they have a fantastic daily Happy Hour plus bottomless mimosas on Saturdays - 7 Minute bike ride to The Big Chill for shopping, dining, and outdoor entertainment including live music on weekends and sports on the Jumbotron - 7 Minute bike ride to dining in Alys Beach including Raw and Juicy, Fonville Press, Charlie's Donut Truck, The Citizen, and George's Alys Beach - All one level! No stairs - Parking for 4 vehicles: 2 vehicles in garage and driveway parking for 2 vehicles - Covered patio with outdoor lounge featuring outdoor TV, gas fire pit and cushioned seating set - Outdoor dining for 6 and outdoor gas grill - Outdoor shower with hot water - Poolside lounge chairs - Full kitchen with stainless steel appliances from Whirlpool and Cuisinart - Dining area with seating for 5 plus nearby breakfast bar seating for 4 - Main living room with a large flat screen TV (indoor fireplace is decorative) - Cable and WIFI throughout home - Laundry room with washer and dryer plus extra ice maker - Concierge services including golf cart rentals, baby equipment rentals, grocery delivery, and beach chair rentals available. - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Tucked away among the quiet Seabreeze neighborhood in Seacrest, this beautiful and comfortable home is perfect for your entire family. Even your pup! What makes this quiet street even better is how close it is to the Seabreeze Beach Access - less than 2 min by bike! In biking distance to shopping and dining at The Big Chill and Waterhouse Sandwich and Wine Bar. The magical and lush landscaped backyard sets the stage for a relaxing and restorative time. The expansive backyard is fenced in with tiled sundeck and a large grassy area for the kids and pup to run around. The large trees canopy the pool area to offer shade, while still being able to enjoy direct sunshine in other areas of the sundeck. You'll want to enjoy this private oasis day and night thanks to the outdoor lounge with fire pit and outdoor TV. The well-appointed home includes an open main living area and full kitchen large enough for multiple people to cook together. Dining available for everyone at the dining table overlooking the pool deck and the nearby breakfast bar. Dine al fresco in the backyard! An outdoor table and grill are available. Don't forget your furry family member either! Your dog wants to romp around 30A, too. This designer home and neighborhood is pet friendly. *Must have written approval from Exclusive 30A to bring your pet and pay a non-refundable pet fee. Bringing an unauthorized pet will result in fines and possible eviction. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
